operations.body: Each of the 35 source-compatible disjoint-cut proper pairs was rebuilt from Entry 1257's ordered integer focus geometry. All 150 proper–proper pairs are now classified; only 70 one-cut-total pairs remain.

operations.title: Benincasa closes all asymmetric proper–proper two-wall systems
operations.body: Entry 1262 closes all 35 disjoint-cut four-focus systems: each has an exact unit staged resultant. Together with Entry 1261, all 150 proper–proper pairs are classified (10 force t=0; 140 have empty stationary locus). The only unresolved two-wall class is the 70 one-cut-total pairs, which require endpoint variance rather than ordinary proper-wall equations.
